messages:
alex: Quick sync — we need a deterministic precedence for flag scope overrides (org/project/route/model). Example below, @maria can you confirm product intent?

maria: TL;DR we want the most specific scope to win. Clarify what "most specific" means for us though.

sam: My read: route > model > project > org. Route is per-route override, model is per-model default, project is team default, org is org-wide.

irina: +1 to route > model > project > org. Also propose a 'hard-block' vs 'soft-default' concept so org can force-disable if needed.

alex: concrete example to reason about:
```
org.allow_feature = false
project.allow_feature = true
model.allow_feature = true
route.allow_feature = <unset>
```
Question: should the effective value be true or false?

kevin: I think org=false should be a soft-default by default (allows overrides), but we need an explicit org.hard_block=true to prevent any downstream enable. Otherwise teams accidentally blocked.

sam: We don't have a schema field for hard_block. Suggest adding `inheritance_action` enum: `hard-block` | `soft-default`. Default = `soft-default`.

maria: Product preference: org should be able to hard-block for compliance/security reasons, but orgs rarely want that. Default soft-default ok.

irina: Guardrails: when enabling at project/route level and org is soft-default=false, require an approval label and limit canary <= project.max_canary_pct. Also auto-rollback if error_rate > baseline + 3*std within 48h.

alex: Canary audience inheritance question: if model has a canary (e.g., 5% by user_id hash) and route sets a canary too, do we AND the audiences or route overrides?

maria: Route should override model canary, not intersect. Model-level is the fallback. That keeps route owners in control of their specific rollout.

kevin: Agreed. But add a flag `inherit_canary: true|false` so route can choose to inherit+filter if they want intersection semantics. Default = false.

sam: I'll add these fields to the feature flag schema: `inheritance_action`, `inherit_canary`, `max_canary_pct`, `org_hard_block` and update validation rules.

irina: For guardrails we also need SLO hooks: latency, error-rate, and token-cost-per-request delta. If cost delta > 2x baseline and canary_pct > 10% block promotion.

features-bot: Draft created: F-4212 - "flag-scope-inheritance-and-canary-rules". Link: https://redwoodfn/internal/flags/F-4212

alex: Action items: sam -> update schema PR (include validation + examples), irina -> draft guardrail runbook and SLI thresholds, maria -> confirm product wording for hard-block vs soft-default, kevin -> add notes to design doc. Aim to have schema PR + runbook by EOW.

sam: PR branch coming today, will @alex for review.

maria: ack, will leave comments on product phrasing later today.

irina: I'll stub the runbook and open an issue with required SLIs.

alex: Perfect. Thanks all :thumbsup:
